name: agent-orchestra
description: Observable multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code. An orchestrator leads a native Agent Team — project-tailored workers (designed by an agent-architect from quality-floor archetypes) plus a standing reviewer and an adversarial critic — that you watch collaborate live in cmux panes. The gate is objective (a hook re-runs the project's tests/lint/build), frontend work requires Playwright live E2E, and every run appends to an onboarding history index. Includes standard .claude scaffolding, Redmine briefing, and Remote Control flow.
